scope: noninteracting control and controlled distinction between EOM/Hubbard-I and electron–boson SCBA approximations
implementation_change: Expose the stationary SCBA spectral sum diagnostic used in the comparison.
Add a reproducible EOM/Hubbard-I versus SCBA benchmark with a shared noninteracting limit.
claim_boundary: The interacting comparison is intentionally a distinction test: electron–boson SCBA is not claimed to approximate the same Hubbard-U model.
An exact finite-U many-body benchmark and Hubbard electron–electron SCBA remain open.
